A NEW water line run from the utility main or meter to a structure — this page's territory. Minimum depth: 12 in. below frost depth (OPSC 609.1); Lane County frost depth is 12 in., so total minimum trench depth is 24 in. below grade. VERIFIED via Lane County's own Trenching for Utilities page — see 07-oregon-authority.md §1.

The pipe connecting a structure to a public sewer main or an on-site septic system. Minimum 12 in. ground cover (OPSC 718.1), 1/4 in.-per-foot minimum slope toward the discharge point. A sewer lateral connecting to a SEPTIC system overlaps with the septic page's territory — see Septic Install & Repair row below for the boundary.

Trenching for a new electrical service, sub-panel run, or outbuilding power line. Depth varies by method per NEC Table 300.5 (adopted/amended by the Oregon Electrical Specialty Code): 24 in. direct-buried cable, 18 in. PVC/nonmetallic conduit, 6 in. rigid/intermediate metal conduit, as shallow as 12 in. for a GFCI-protected 120V branch circuit. Oregon-specific OESC amendment table not directly confirmed in this pass — flagged in 07-oregon-authority.md §1.

18 in. minimum cover standard (ORSC G2415.12); individual outdoor-appliance lines (grill, light) may be as shallow as 8 in. if approved by the AHJ (G2415.12.1). Requires a yellow tracer wire alongside non-metallic pipe. VERIFIED via Lane County's own Trenching for Utilities page.
